items.title: Ernest Poree Interview, 1975-10-16
items.q: I've been building with them, working on Charles and Dekayla and Dumaine. That was your top-notch club out there, where they were working at.

ctx.x: And this guy, you say, the boss, he comes to and says, what happened Billy? Oh, when I was coming to work, I fell off the streetcar. He said, no, you're lying. I said, because I was looking at you when you were coming here. There wasn't nothing wrong with you with me. I was being brought with me, gushing out of him. So he said, suppose they could suspend him for two weeks. Give him two weeks suspension. We went with our golf. Told the waiters to come back there. Tell us don't come back no more. We all lost the…

I have to kill that Dumaine right on the corner. I forget the name of that club. But we were working out towards the next street down in St. Louis. St. Philip. We were working there close to St. Philip Street.
